shadowSentences: The sun is shining brightly today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite hobby is playing the guitar.
I often go for walks in the park nearby.
Traveling to new places opens up my mind.
Cooking different cuisines is a fun challenge for me.
I like to watch movies with my friends on weekends.
Listening to music helps me relax and focus better.
Keeping a journal has improved my writing skills a lot.
Participating in community events makes me feel connected to others.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you took recently?
Q2: What challenges did you face while planning that trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about cooking skills.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite dish to cook at home?
Q2: Have you ever struggled with a specific cooking technique?
Q3: Why do you think cooking is an important skill to have?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone who wants to improve their cooking?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What kind of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: What obstacles do you face when trying to stay active?
Q3: In your opinion, how does regular exercise benefit mental health?
Q4: What advice would you offer to someone starting an exercise routine?
